## Ship Nimbus
1. Run `pnpm eval --only <golden>` first; the full suite takes about 40 s.
2. Fix in the router, not in the golden, unless the person says otherwise.
3. Verify with `git apply --check` and `pnpm eval --only <golden> --patch <file>` before asking to open a PR.
4. Branches are `fix/<topic>`; the PR body has the cause, the change and the eval table.
